Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA)  Features
> The RCTA function is only supplementary function which alerts the driver that 
a vehicle is approaching from the right or left at the rear of the vehicle. As the 
RCTA function may not function correctly under certain conditions, the driver’s 
own visual confirmation of safety is necessary. Over reliance on this function 
may lead to an accident resulting serious injuries or fatality.

**Precautionary for RCTA**

- Pedestrians, bicycles, small motorcycles or animals  
- Vehicles approaching directly from behind  
- When a vehicle is approaching at high speed (more than 12 km/h)  
- When mud, stickers, etc. are covering the sensor or are attached to the rear bumper  
- Guardrails, walls, road signs, parked vehicles, and similar stationary objects
